SQLiteBookmarkDAO is a data access object (DAO) that provides methods for interacting with the Bookmarks table in the SQLite database.
SQLiteHistoryDAO
SQLiteHistoryDAO is a data access object (DAO) that provides methods for interacting with the History table in the SQLite database.
SQLitePlantDAO
SQLitePlantDAO is an implementation of the IPlantDAO interface that interacts with the application's SQLite database.
SQLiteUserDAO

User
User is a record that represents a user in the application, containing their username, password, and role.
